note: Written 4 Sep 2026. The survey is a one-page 1983 data form with no measured description; it states the bay count and storey count and nothing else dimensional. `new-england-federal` also names this building and its exemplar was not touched (that node is not in this package's scope); add it to `nodes[]` when that exemplar gains a `precedent`.
